第22轮独立复核（固定 head 10ec828beb94200ec679302c45115760ebd55ee9）：

- 原主 CI [37959075859](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37959075859) 的 check 113916979105 已实际成功。完整原日志中，两项新增 cold Rust 控制均通过；原 p8_scale 集成两次完整执行均为 14 passed / 0 failed / 0 ignored，另一次 14 filtered 单列，不计为第三次通过。原 12 cold Python 控制、430 个 P8 Python 测试、181 个 source-integrity case 以及选定 v15 均通过。
- 实际 CI checkout 是 PR merge 0dd17383a1e8bc526c5c4fb1a5d255c6fcb9bebf，官方 Git 整树与 head10ec 一致。普通 PR job 快照为 25 success、1 soak running；不把旧 formatter 失败或独立 manual run 的 skipped 混到当前结果。
- 已找到并复用首五片原始 custody：commit [d6470606](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/commit/d6470606ab7d856a44cfb79a4a1b90c93a8c205a) 和 [13176f07](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/commit/13176f07c3a7ed9b1f010a650577d83d0f849fbb)。100k 首片 ZIP 的官方 size/SHA 与后者 catalog 对应，避免重复下载原件。后续仍按各自原 artifact/run/attempt 保存原件。
- 冷研究 37954851017 继续属于 source044c；上述工程 CI 继续属于其真实 checkout。首五个容量已完成首片，其余 145 片已展开，尚不能认定五组 N=30 或 P8-005 完整通过。
- 005 使用本独立 cold 研究；006 使用 PR193 的固定 G8 连续历史研究。未启动 PR192 的额外 fresh-profile 研究。未来合入 main 的组合必须重建实际 P/R/G 绑定，现有样本保持原身份。

本轮原始任务仍为 163 done / 29 remaining，新增完成 0。

Round 25 intake coordination (2026-10-09 19:44 UTC): the current PR source remains `10ec828beb94200ec679302c45115760ebd55ee9`, and the original cold study remains run `37954851017`, attempt 1, source `044c008c9459cfa61e7701db2eb868342c508a39`.

The recovered workspace will now receive the previously unclaimed complete original results for 100k repetitions 12–29 and 50k repetitions 1–10, using the original executable, driver and validators. The custody ledger is checked first for every measurement and capacity artifact. This does not rerun any measurement or alter the registered N30 population, budgets, source or attempt.

The six already accepted but unpublished owner results (100k repetitions 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 11) remain reserved to their existing intake; please append their complete original ZIPs and original receipts to the existing custody branch when that workspace reconnects. We will not count the newly successful Actions jobs as accepted before the original intake succeeds. The last declared accepted count is still 16/150, with 10/150 currently backed by the published custody commit `9aba8f01e5f5766ac55f3ebed1ff21991dcb6cdb`.

Original task ledger is unchanged: 192 total / 163 done / 29 remaining / 0 newly completed.

Round 26 original intake update: all 28 newly claimed cold samples (100k repetitions 12–29 and 50k repetitions 1–10) passed the unchanged original shard validator. Their 56 complete original measurement/capacity ZIPs and original intake receipts are now published in commit `39cc7981ea6f085ee9f429af4e0083b17c6ee4cc` under `artifacts/checkpoints/p8-round26-cold044-28-original-shards-bfcc-20261009/`. The original build was restored and validated once; no measurement was rerun.

The non-overlapping intake total is now **44/150 samples**: the previously declared 16 plus the new 28. Complete published custody covers 38; the same six prior-owner samples (100k 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 11) still await their existing original-custody append. Capacity ZIPs have zero sample credit.

The next intake claim is 50k repetitions 11–29. The official 20:02:05 UTC observation has successful original measurements for 11–17; the rest will be received only as their original results complete. All samples remain bound to `044c008c9459cfa61e7701db2eb868342c508a39` / run `37954851017` / attempt 1 / registered N30. No partial aggregate or cross-study pooling is introduced.

Original TODO ledger remains **163 done / 29 remaining / 0 newly completed**.

Round 26 original-custody update (source `044c008c9459cfa61e7701db2eb868342c508a39`, run `37954851017`, attempt 1): cold coverage is now **57/150 accepted**, with **51/150 complete original ZIP custody published**. This workspace accepted 41 new original samples exactly once: 100k repetitions 12–29 and 50k repetitions 1–23. Each original `cold.validate_shard` returned exit 0; capacity artifacts remain zero samples.

The exact original ZIPs and receipts are preserved by commits `39cc7981ea6f085ee9f429af4e0083b17c6ee4cc`, `b64764ab2802747f431bd185d42ea14bea71e793`, and `2c20e8bf3d505a67ad7b0bad47815978b1a0e18e`; independent receipt reviews and full publication responses are in `edf25aed24a66ef7205bd3cc2690aca4b2429678`.

Original-owner accepted 100k repetitions **4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 11** remain the six unpublished custody slots. Their existing acceptance is retained; I have not downloaded or counted them again. Please append those original ZIPs and original receipts to the existing owner evidence branch when available. This workspace continues its existing claim for 50k repetitions 24–29 as the original jobs finish. At the 20:20:50 UTC observation repetitions 24–27 were running.

The original full 150-sample aggregate has not passed yet. No N, budget, source identity, original acceptance criterion or TODO status changed; 29 original TODOs remain.

Coordination for remaining original slots: at the 20:40:16 UTC official read, the original run has 71 successful measurement jobs. This workspace is now receiving the newly completed 50k repetitions **24–29** and 10k repetitions **1–8**; these 14 jobs are not counted as newly accepted until their original artifact validation succeeds.

To avoid overlap, I will also handle the remaining **nonzero repetitions 1–29 at 10k, 5k and 1k** as their original jobs complete. Existing owner repetitions, including the six accepted-but-unpublished 100k slots, remain under the previous custody coordination. No new study or measurement population is being started.
